title: Text
description: The two kinds of text the report's inputs hold. A Word document's XML holds no control character but the tab and the line feed, so neither kind admits any other.

line.title: Line
line.description: One line of text: no line break, no tab and no other control character, and at least one character.

prose.title: Prose
prose.description: Text of one or more paragraphs, each line break starting a new one. It holds no control character but the line feed and the tab, and at least one character.
